title: Fast-forward any explicit finite rational Markov generator at binary times
statement: For an EXPLICIT S-state rational generator Q with complete description length H, binary rational T>=0 and 0<eta<1, the supplied construction samples a reachable state within unconditional endpoint TV eta on EVERY run, in polynomial(S,H,bits(T),log(1/eta)) bit work, RAM and random bits. Set U=I+Q/Lambda, choose h so s=Lambda*T/2^h<=1/2, and use the positive normalized finite matrix M_s=(sum_(k<=K) s^k U^k/k!)/(sum_(k<=K)s^k/k!), with omitted Poisson tail<=2^-K. Floor off-diagonal entries to2^-b and assign residual to the diagonal; perform h rounded squares. Row-TV error obeys E_(j+1)<=2E_j+S2^-b; b=h+ceil(log2(16(S+1)/eta)), K sufficiently large O(b), pays all accumulated errors. Integer heights remain polynomial and the final dyadic row uses bounded random bits. Root independently supplied the equivalent certified-lower-exp coefficient plus diagonal-tail variant for the one-particle spatial kernel. Both preserve path support. There is no succinct-generator shortcut, numeric-time trajectory loop, unbounded rejection or free exact exponential.
